settings.title: Settings
settings.lang.help: Pick the language the app speaks. Your projects and takes stay exactly as they are.
settings.lang.restart: Done. Close and reopen GuitarCam and it will speak your language.
mode.video.tip: Video project: one panel per track, camera and MP4 export
mode.audio.tip: Audio-only project: no camera or video; you export the mix as WAV or MP3. You can go back to Video whenever you like: nothing gets deleted
title.dsp.tip: Audio callback load: above 80 % it can crackle
transport.monitor.tip: Hear yourself through the app (monitoring). Turn it on only if your interface has no direct monitoring: it adds latency
transport.stop.tip: Stop (returns to where it started; if already stopped, to the start)
transport.rec.arm.tip: Arm a track (●) to be able to record (R)
transport.rec.stop.tip: Stop and save the channel (Space / R)
title.ffmpeg.missing.tip: FFmpeg not found in the PATH: you won't be able to export
title.ffmpeg.missing.status: I couldn't find FFmpeg in the PATH: install it to export and see the video.
mode.status.audio: Audio-only project: the camera is free and you export the mix as WAV or MP3. Your videos are still saved.
mode.status.video: Video project: the camera and the composition are back.
export.audio.tip: Export the mix as WAV or MP3
click.hint.1: Dry woodblock, cuts through the guitar
click.hint.2: High and short, audible over distortion
click.hint.5: Kick on 1, hi-hat on the rest
click.pick.tip: Click to pick it and hear it
transport.clock.bars.tip: Bar.beat.sixteenth · {0} · click: show minutes and seconds
transport.rec.none: Arm a track (●) to be able to record
insp.title: Channel
insp.knob.tip: {0}: {1} (drag or use the wheel · double click: {2})
insp.empty.b: (or the record button) and the new channel lands right here on the timeline.
insp.empty.c: You can also add a channel from the history here with “New track”.
insp.inVideo.tip: The track has its panel in the video. Turn it off to make it sound only (a backing track, a click…)
insp.sat.hint: How hard the channel pushes into the tube or the tape. It is calibrated to the channel level
insp.sat.tape.hint: Tightens the hits, smooths harsh highs and adds a bit of body to the lows.
insp.sat.tube.hint: Even harmonics: warmer and rounder, peaks soften without losing sparkle.
insp.comp.manual.tip: Hand-set values: pick a style to go back to the simple control
insp.comp.amount.tip: Amount: {0}. Moves everything together (compression, attack, release, EQ) and keeps the volume even (drag or use the wheel · double click: medium)
insp.comp.rhythm.hint: Rhythm and riffs: evens out the hits, keeps the pick attack and leaves room for the lead
insp.comp.arpeggio.hint: Arpeggios and clean tones: evens out the strings, soft notes are heard and it sounds open
insp.comp.lead.hint: Solos and melodies: more sustain, even notes and presence so it sits up front
insp.comp.makeup.hint: Make-up: makes up for the volume the compression takes away
insp.comp.presence.hint: Positive: the guitar comes forward. Negative: leaves room for another one
insp.comp.limit.tip: A limiter after the compressor catches pick hits and loud notes
insp.comp.fine.hint: Moving these values switches the compressor to “Manual”. Pick a style to go back to the simple control.
insp.reverb.hint: How much of this track goes to the reverb bus (after the fader)
insp.delay.hint: How much of this track goes to the delay bus (after the fader)
insp.sync.offset.hint: Fixes this channel’s audio sync (negative = earlier). Includes the latency compensation; the timeline snap respects it
insp.sync.camera.hint: Makes up for the camera delay so the fingers match the audio
insp.clip.trimStart.hint: Hides the start of the channel without moving the rest
insp.clip.linkFades: The video follows the audio fades
insp.clip.linkFades.tip: The video fades to black along with the volume
insp.clip.hint: On the timeline: drag the clip to move it, its edges to trim and the top corners for fades.
insp.frame.hint: Drag the panel in the video to move the framing; the mouse wheel zooms.
insp.removeClip.hint: The file stays saved; you can use it again from History.
insp.none.hint: Click a track or its panel in the video.
insp.none.empty: No channels recorded yet. The guitar is waiting.
clip.offline: Offline: the audio file is missing
snap.hint.1: Sticks to the start of each bar
snap.hint.2: Sticks to every half note (half a bar)
snap.hint.3: Sticks to every quarter note (every beat)
snap.on.tip: Grid snap ({0}): {1}. Used by the playhead, moving clips, trims and fades (Alt: no snap)
snap.off.tip: Snap is off: everything moves freely. Pick a grid so the playhead, clips, trims and fades stick to the beat
timeline.viewSaveError: I couldn’t remember the timeline view: {0}
timeline.editError: I couldn’t finish the timeline edit: {0}. You can undo the change.
timeline.split.pick: Pick a track and put the playhead on the clip you want to split.
timeline.split.nowhere: The playhead isn’t over any clip on this track: put it where you want to cut.
timeline.dup.pick: Pick the clip you want to duplicate.
range.deleted: Deleted {0:0.00} s from the track: the gap stays and nothing else moved. You can undo it.
range.nothing: There was nothing to delete in that range.
menu.clipKept.many: The clip’s file stays in History.
menu.clipKept.last: Removing the clip leaves the track empty. The file stays in History.
timeline.empty.title: No tracks yet
timeline.empty.a: Create a track with “New track”, arm it with its ● and record the base with R.
timeline.empty.b: On the next channels you’ll hear the earlier ones while you play.
tl.tip.headerWidth: Drag to change the width of the track columns
tl.tip.ruler: Click or drag: move the playhead (Alt: no snap) · Shift+wheel: zoom · Alt+wheel: height · middle click: pan
tl.tip.armed: Armed: the next channel{0} is recorded on this track · click to disarm
tl.tip.arm.empty: Arm to record on this track (you can arm several and record them at once)
tl.tip.arm.replace: Arm to record on this track: the new channel replaces the one it has (it stays in History)
tl.tip.input: Input: where this track records from
tl.tip.removeTrack: Remove the track from the timeline (the file stays in History) · right click: more options
tl.tip.fxOn: {0} on: click to turn it off
tl.tip.fxOff: {0} off: click to turn it on
tl.tip.clip: Drag to move (Alt: no snap; up/down: to another track) · edges: trim · top corners: fades
tl.tip.beforeZero: This part sits before 0 and is neither heard nor seen
act.ghost.recorded: You recorded {0} that you later deleted
act.ghost.moved: You moved {0} that you later deleted
act.importedWeb: You imported the project from the web app
act.versionBack: You went back to the version
act.adopted: I added files that were in media:
color.tpl.name: Template name
color.adj.vibrance.hint: Saturates dull colors more than vivid ones
color.adj.fade.hint: Lifts the blacks, like a washed-out photo
color.tpl.saveCurrent.tip: Save the current filter, adjustments and effects as a template
color.fx.vignette.hint: Darkens the edges of each panel
color.fx.vignetteSize.hint: Bigger = starts farther from the center
color.fx.grain.hint: Film grain, it moves frame by frame
color.letterbox.tip0: Bars above and below each panel, widescreen format
color.fx.hint: Everything applies to the whole video, the same in the preview and in the MP4 (the grain is random, so it matches in intensity, not grain by grain). Double click a value to reset it.
color.tpl.empty: Save the filter, adjustments and effects as a template to use in other projects.
color.tpl.delete.name: Delete template {0}
color.tpl.saveError: I couldn’t save the video templates: {0}
hist.openFolder.tip: Open the project folder in Explorer
hist.empty: The channels you record will show up here.
hist.noUnused: No unused channels: they are all on the timeline.
hist.exports.empty.audio: The audio files you export show up here, wherever they are.
hist.exports.empty.video: The MP4s you export show up here, wherever they are.
hist.activity.empty: Nothing has happened in this project yet.
hist.listen: Listen to the channel (just the recorded audio, no effects)
hist.removeFromTimeline: Remove from the timeline (the file stays saved)
hist.use.tip: Add it back to the timeline
hist.trashFile: Send the file to the Recycle Bin
hist.trashVideo: Send the video to the Recycle Bin
hist.purge.confirm: You’re about to send {0} ({1}) to the Recycle Bin. If you get it wrong, you can recover them from there.
hist.err.notFound: I couldn’t find the file for “{0}”.
hist.err.moved: I couldn’t find the file: was it moved or deleted?
